description: This file defines a UI-specific service class 'CatalogViewModelService' used in an ASP.NET Core web application. It provides methods to retrieve catalog items with filtering, pagination, and related data such as brands and types, primarily for populating view models and dropdown lists.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A UI-specific service class that provides methods for retrieving catalog data, brands, and types for view models.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of catalog items based on optional brand and type filters, including associated metadata like total items and pagination info.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available brands formatted as select list items, including an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available catalog types formatted as select list items, including an 'All' option.
